messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_4]
Query: I'm starting the render phase shown on this whiteboard next Wednesday at 9:00 AM. Figure out exactly when it will finish, and set a reminder for 6 hours before that to check on the project mentioned in the bottom left tweet by warp5 on this screen.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to calculate the exact finish time for the render phase shown on the whiteboard, assuming it starts next Wednesday at 9:00 AM. Then ask it to set a reminder for 6 hours before that finish time to check on the project mentioned in the bottom-left tweet by 'warp5' on the screen display. If the assistant asks for clarification on the math, confirm it should be exactly the duration shown on the board from the start time, minus 6 hours. Proceed to the next step once the reminder is set.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_2]
Query: Now look at this notepad recap. Count the bullet points under 'OUTSTANDING WORK', multiply that by 5 to get my total story points, and update my story points task with that number. I'll tell you which task if there are multiple. Also, make new individual tasks for each of the items listed under QUALITIES.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to look at the notepad recap, count the bullet points under 'OUTSTANDING WORK', multiply that count by 5, and update your 'story points' task with that calculated number. Also, ask it to create separate new tasks for each item listed under '* QUALITIES *'. The assistant will find multiple 'story points' tasks ('Story Points - Web Redesign' and 'Story Points - Mobile App') and present them or ask which one to update. When it does, select the 'Web Redesign' one via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant you mean the Web Redesign one. Move on once all tasks are updated and created.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_3]
Query: Finally, check out this sketchnote. Count the checkboxes under 'Things to try'. Multiply that count by $12 to estimate supply costs, then subtract that from the 'Remaining Budget' in my 'Project Budget' note and update the note with the new balance.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to count the checkboxes under 'Things to try' in the sketchnote, multiply that number by $12, and then subtract that total from the 'Remaining Budget' in your 'Project Budget' note. Tell it to update the note with the new calculated balance. Once the note is successfully updated, you can end the conversation.
